O território que queremos acompanhar: The area we aim to monitor
Resíduos em rios, canais e na Baía de Gu: Waste in rivers, canals and Guanabara Bay needs observation over time. A photo shows only a snapshot: on its own, it does not describe the entire water body or its current condition.
Conectar fotografias, localização, revis: Connect photographs, location, review and history to make environmental observations more organized and useful for public participation, research and action planning.
Moradores, estudantes e pessoas que circ: Residents, students and people visiting the area can contribute observations. Methodology, traceability and human review provide context. More submissions do not automatically mean more pollution.
O modelo identifica objetos visíveis na: The model identifies visible objects in an image and reports counts and confidence. It can miss or confuse objects. The team reviews evidence before publication; AI does not prove authenticity, channel blockage or contamination.
O projeto aproxima o cuidado com o ambie: The project connects care for the environment, wildlife and people. Recorded signs are environmental observations, not medical or veterinary diagnoses.
Água, margens, resíduos e sinais visívei: Water, banks, waste and visible signs in the area.
Vegetação, aves, fauna aquática e animai: Vegetation, birds, aquatic fauna and animals near waste.
Participação, educação ambiental e segur: Participation, environmental education and observer safety.
Comunidades, educadores, estudantes, pes: Communities, educators, students, researchers, environmental organizations and teams monitoring locations and documenting actions. Scientific use must consider uneven coverage, review and index limitations.
Construir memória dos locais, revelar la: Build a record of locations, reveal observation gaps and support actions documented with before-and-after evidence. This is a working vision, not a promise of environmental outcomes.
SHA-256 dos pesos do modelo disponíveis: SHA-256 of the model weights available in this release
Critérios detalhados de AquaVerify, pHas: Detailed AquaVerify, pHash and hotspot criteria
Recebidos e validados são contagens de r: Received and validated counts refer to photographic reports without exposing private individual data. Water bodies include validated public sessions, including no-waste observations. Objects and hotspots use only validated public reports. Objects are summed detections, not unique items across photos. There is no user ranking.
O nível ambiental é declarado pelo usuár: The environmental level is reported by the user and reviewed by the team. WPS combines the level (70%) with the frequency of distinct photos (30%); CS combines average AI confidence with a community factor of 0.8. Coverage counts distinct days, not pollution intensity. Hotspots describe observed persistence.
Registro oportunístico é uma foto avulsa: An opportunistic report is a standalone photo. Structured monitoring records start, end, segment and distance actually observed. Items per metre, per 100 m and per minute are only shown for eligible reviewed sessions.
O detector identifica sacolas, garrafas,: The detector identifies bags, bottles, packaging and other plastics. Confidence is a model measure for detected objects, not the probability that a report is true. It does not determine authenticity, severity, contamination or blockage. A complete training dataset card is not available in this application; the hash identifies the weights actually used.
São registrados foto, localização declar: Records include the photo, declared/confirmed location, available GPS accuracy, submission time, SHA-256, pHash, model version/hash, result, reviewer and stage history. Every public observation exposes its traceability. EXIF capture time, when present, is not authenticated.
Somente relatos validados e autorizados: Only validated reports with consent are published. Receipt and session codes are private and stored as hashes. Contributors track reports on the website; no external notifications are sent automatically. No-visible-waste observations remain in the history.
“Não temos dado” é diferente de “o trech: No data is different from a segment that was observed with no visible waste. The gap map covers registered planned segments, not all rivers in the region. Manual coordinates, GPS, water body names and distances may contain errors. No detection does not prove absence of waste.
pHash sinaliza possíveis semelhanças e p: pHash flags possible similarities and can be wrong. Distance-based rates depend on declared coverage and may count the same object in different photos. Before/after comparisons are descriptive and do not demonstrate causation. Thresholds and weights are experimental heuristics.
Todos os relatos aguardam revisão antes: All reports await review before publication. The team confirms the water body and assesses similarity. It can then document recurrence, referral, action, follow-up and resolution with a responsible person, date and reason. Resolved is a recorded team decision, not an automatic AI guarantee.
A área da equipe usa senha compartilhada: The team area uses a shared password and a self-reported reviewer name; individual reviewer authentication is not available.
Registros legados sem versão gravada são: Older records without a saved version are identified as legacy records; the current version is not assigned retroactively.
